name: Olympia Capital Holdings Ltd
source: Issuer audited consolidated statement of comprehensive income, KShs thousands converted to absolute KShs. FY2026 and FY2025 columns from the OCHL 2026 audited financials for publication, signed by Felix Kimanthi (Chief Executive Officer) and Dr. Chris W. Obura (Chairman). FY2024 column from the audited financials summary published on the Nairobi Securities Exchange.
source_note: Audited annual figures for the three years ended 28 February 2026, 2025 and 2024, each row as the issuer printed it in KShs thousands and multiplied by 1000 to the absolute-KShs convention. Arithmetic checked before writing: Revenue less Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit; Gross Profit plus Other Operating Income less Operating Expenses equals Operating Profit; Operating Profit less Net Finance Costs equals Profit Before Tax; Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit, exactly in all three years. Replaces an earlier single-period file that stored the same FY2026 revenue in KShs thousands and therefore rendered one thousand times too small.
